title: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Climate (ՀՀ օրենք Կլիմայի մասին), No. ՀՕ-17-Ն
citation: ՀՕ-17-Ն; adopted 2026-01-20 (National Assembly), signed 2026-02-12, officially published 2026-02-13 on the Unified Site
evidence: Art. 40 para. 1: "Սույն օրենքն ուժի մեջ է մտնում պաշտոնական հրապարակման օրվան հաջորդող տասներորդ օրը:"; the arlis.am metadata block gives "Պաշտոնական հրապարակման օրը 13.02.2026" and "Ուժի մեջ մտնելու ամսաթիվ 23.02.2026". Opened https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/220890/print/act on 2026-11-03.
notes: Armenia's climate framework act. Its company duties are F3 and F1 content inside the same act: GHG emission permit (Art. 23), carbon pricing instruments (Art. 24, enabling only), GHG accounting and publication (Art. 25), published climate information (Arts. 35 and 36), liability (Art. 39). The numeric permit threshold is not in the act. Art. 40 sets Government and ministerial deadlines of 3 to 36 months for the implementing acts; on 2026-11-03 arlis.am title searches for 2026 (Կլիմայի, ջերմոցային) found only two Prime Minister decisions, N 320-Ա (list of implementing measures, docID 224022) and N 844-Ա (council and working groups, docID 230562), which are plans and orders of the Prime Minister, not stored. No framework environmental protection act exists as an enacted instrument on arlis.am: the EIA law is in register.csv as F7. No carbon pricing instrument and no exchange or regulator sustainability disclosure rule was found (see AM-CBA-ADOPTED and AM-AMX-ADOPTED). The act is the first version served: arlis.am has no earlier text and no amendment of it on 2026-11-03. Language: Armenian (hy), the only official language, one record. No government English text: the arlis.am page of this act lists no other-language version (checked 2026-11-03) and the /en interface search found no English text for the climate, consumer rights or advertising titles; the environment.gov.am home page links no English text of it either.

title: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Atmospheric Air Protection (ՀՀ օրենք Մթնոլորտային օդի պահպանության մասին), No. ՀՕ-121, incorporated text
citation: ՀՕ-121 of 1994-10-11 (Supreme Council), incorporation as amended up to ՀՕ-18-Ն of 2026-01-20
evidence: The arlis.am metadata block gives adoption 11.10.1994 and signature 01.11.1994 and leaves "Ուժի մեջ մտնելու ամսաթիվ" empty, so no official page states the first in-force date. The incorporation stored is valid from 23.02.2026: "Կարգավիճակ Գործում է (23.02.2026-մինչ օրս)". Opened https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/220906/print/act on 2026-11-03.
notes: The act holds the GHG emission permit regime for legal entities and individual entrepreneurs with stationary sources (permit application and register, monitoring plan, revocation, duties of emitters), added by ՀՕ-18-Ն (am-air-protection-amendment-2026) and referred to by the Climate Law, Art. 23. The first in-force date is null because no official page states it. One record: the current incorporation, dated by its validity start 2026-02-23. arlis.am serves no earlier incorporation (the change-history table links to unrelated documents), so the 1994 text and the versions before 2026-02-23 are not stored. arlis.am types this text 'Ինկորպորացիա', without the 'Պաշտոնական ինկորպորացիա' badge. Language: Armenian (hy), one record. No government English text: the arlis.am page of this act lists no other-language version (checked 2026-11-03) and the /en interface search found no English text for the climate, consumer rights or advertising titles; /ru lists only the Russian text of an amending act of 2001, not the base law.

title: Law of the Republic of Armenia on amendments and supplements to the Law on Atmospheric Air Protection (ՀՀ օրենք «Մթնոլորտային օդի պահպանության մասին» օրենքում լրացումներ և փոփոխություններ կատարելու մասին), No. ՀՕ-18-Ն
evidence: Art. 12 para. 1: "Սույն օրենքն ուժի մեջ է մտնում պաշտոնական հրապարակման օրվան հաջորդող տասներորդ օրը:"; the metadata block gives "Ուժի մեջ մտնելու ամսաթիվ 23.02.2026". Opened https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/220873/print/act on 2026-11-03.
notes: Companion of the Climate Law, adopted the same day. It inserts the GHG emission permit provisions into the Law on Atmospheric Air Protection (46 mentions of greenhouse gases). Stored as enacted so the change of 2026-02-23 is dated even though arlis.am serves no earlier incorporation of the base law. Language: Armenian (hy), one record. No government English text: the arlis.am page of this act lists no other-language version (checked 2026-11-03) and the /en interface search found no English text for the climate, consumer rights or advertising titles.

title: Government of Armenia Decision No. 54-Ն of 11 January 2024 on approving the procedure for the inventory of greenhouse gas emissions (ՀՀ կառավարության որոշումը ջերմոցային գազերի արտանետումների գույքագրման կարգը հաստատելու մասին)
citation: Government Decision N 54-Ն of 2024-01-11, signed 2024-01-12, published 2024-01-12 on the Unified Site
evidence: Point 5: "Սույն որոշումն ուժի մեջ է մտնում պաշտոնական հրապարակմանը հաջորդող օրվանից։"; the metadata block gives "Պաշտոնական հրապարակման օրը 12.01.2024" and "Ուժի մեջ մտնելու ամսաթիվ 13.01.2024". Opened https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/188713/print/act on 2026-11-03.
notes: Made under the Law on Atmospheric Air Protection Art. 5 para. 1 point 5, before the Climate Law. The annex defines a 'respondent' (a legal entity or individual entrepreneur with stationary GHG sources, including foreign branches) that supplies inventory data in the annexed forms to the Ministry of Environment. The Climate Law Art. 27 covers inventory and cadastre again; arlis.am still shows this decision as in force ("Գործում է") on 2026-11-03. No amendment of it was found, so one record. Language: Armenian (hy), one record. No government English text: the arlis.am page of this act lists no other-language version (checked 2026-11-03) and the /en interface search found no English text for the climate, consumer rights or advertising titles.

title: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Protection of Consumer Rights (ՀՀ օրենք Սպառողների իրավունքների պաշտպանության մասին), No. ՀՕ-197, incorporated text
citation: ՀՕ-197 of 2001-06-26, signed 2001-07-20; incorporation as amended up to ՀՕ-178-Ն of 2026-04-16
evidence: The arlis.am metadata block gives adoption 26.06.2001 and "Ուժի մեջ մտնելու ամսաթիվ 01.01.2002". The incorporation stored is valid from 01.07.2026: "Կարգավիճակ Գործում է (01.07.2026-մինչ օրս)". Opened https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/226867/print/act on 2026-11-03.
notes: Umbrella consumer law for environmental claims: Art. 1 point 27 defines 'էկոլոգիական հավաստում' (environmental claim), and Art. 37.2 para. 4 point 3 lists, among the commercial actions that are misleading in every case, an environmental claim about a whole product or a whole business activity when it concerns one specific feature of the product or one line of the seller's activity (read from the stored text, not from how it is applied). One record: the current incorporation, dated 2026-07-01. The amendment that brought the environmental-claim text is stored as am-consumer-rights-amendment-2026; earlier incorporations are not served by arlis.am (the change-history table links to unrelated documents). arlis.am types this text 'Ինկորպորացիա', without the 'Պաշտոնական ինկորպորացիա' badge. Language: Armenian (hy), one record. A Russian text of the original 2001 act exists (docID 63621, ЗР-197) and is not stored: Russian is not an official language, it carries no amendment state matching the stored version, and no translation row passed. No English text on arlis.am (/en search 'Consumer Rights': no result).

title: Law of the Republic of Armenia on amendments and supplements to the Law on Protection of Consumer Rights (ՀՀ օրենք «Սպառողների իրավունքների պաշտպանության մասին» օրենքում փոփոխություններ և լրացումներ կատարելու մասին), No. ՀՕ-178-Ն
evidence: Art. 14: "Սույն օրենքն ուժի մեջ է մտնում 2026 թվականի հուլիսի 1-ից:"; the metadata block gives "Ուժի մեջ մտնելու ամսաթիվ 01.07.2026". Opened https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/224775/print/act on 2026-11-03.
notes: Inserts the environmental-claim definition (Art. 1 point 27 of the base law) among its changes. Stored as enacted so the date of the change is on record. Language: Armenian (hy), one record. No government English text: the arlis.am page of this act lists no other-language version (checked 2026-11-03) and the /en interface search found no English text for the climate, consumer rights or advertising titles.

title: Law of the Republic of Armenia on Advertising (ՀՀ օրենք Գովազդի մասին), No. ՀՕ-55, incorporated text
citation: ՀՕ-55 of 1996-04-30, signed 1996-05-25; incorporation as amended up to ՀՕ-400-Ն of 2026-07-03
evidence: The arlis.am metadata block gives adoption 30.04.1996 and "Ուժի մեջ մտնելու ամսաթիվ 31.05.1996". The incorporation stored is valid from 30.08.2026: "Կարգավիճակ Գործում է (30.08.2026-մինչ օրս)". Opened https://www.arlis.am/hy/acts/230017/print/act on 2026-11-03.
notes: General advertising law (false and misleading advertising); it has no environmental-claim provision of its own. It mentions the environment only in the list of advertising harmful to society (calls and arguments against the environment) and in the public-danger clause. The environmental-claim definition sits in the Consumer Rights Law. One record: the current incorporation, dated 2026-08-30, carrying the 'Պաշտոնական ինկորպորացիա' badge. Other recent amending acts: ՀՕ-179-Ն (in force 2026-07-01, docID 224782) and ՀՕ-350-Ն (docID 228523, tied to the gambling law, no in-force date); neither mentions the environment, so neither is stored. Earlier incorporations are not served by arlis.am. Language: Armenian (hy), one record. No government English text: the arlis.am page of this act lists no other-language version (checked 2026-11-03) and the /en interface search found no English text for the climate, consumer rights or advertising titles.
